name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: A public health assurance scheme that pays for hospital care at empanelled public and private hospitals, without the patient paying at the counter.
coverage_amount: Up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
eligibility: Families identified using SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria. Citizens aged 70 and above are also covered, regardless of income.
target_beneficiaries: Economically vulnerable families and senior citizens aged 70+.
key_features: Cashless, paperless treatment at empanelled hospitals
Usable in any state (portable across India)
No cap on family size or age
Pre-existing conditions covered from day one
Covers a wide package list of procedures across specialities
income_note: Eligibility is SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational category, not a published income figure. ₹1,20,000 a year approximates the bottom-40% threshold.
notes: Over 42 crore Ayushman Cards issued as of late 2025 per government/media reporting; figures updated periodically.

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementing_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: One-time financial help for patients living below the poverty line who need treatment for a life-threatening disease at a government hospital.
coverage_amount: Assistance per case, as sanctioned by the scheme's committee. Check the official site for current limits.
eligibility: Patients below the poverty line with a life-threatening illness, treated at a government hospital.
target_beneficiaries: BPL patients with major illnesses such as cancer, heart and kidney disease.
key_features: Grant goes to the treating government hospital
income_note: The test is BPL status on the state BPL list, not a published rupee figure. ₹1,00,000 a year approximates the BPL threshold.

name: Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Earlier smart-card based health insurance for BPL families. Its work has been taken over by Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
coverage_amount: Historically ₹30,000 per family per year. No longer enrolling.
eligibility: Was open to BPL families. Not accepting new enrolment.
target_beneficiaries: Formerly BPL families and unorganised-sector workers.
income_note: The test was BPL status. ₹1,00,000 a year approximates the BPL threshold (scheme now closed).

name: Ayushman Bharat Health & Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandir)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Upgraded sub-centres and primary health centres that offer a wider range of primary care close to home, including screening and follow-up for common long-term conditions.
coverage_amount: Free primary care services at the centre.
eligibility: Open to everyone in the catchment area.
target_beneficiaries: All citizens, especially rural and semi-urban populations.
key_features: Screening for diabetes, hypertension and common cancers

name: Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementing_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: A large investment programme to build up health systems: primary care, critical care blocks, laboratories and disease surveillance.
coverage_amount: Multi-year central and state outlay for infrastructure, not payments to individuals.
eligibility: Not applied for by individuals. Benefits reach people through improved facilities.
target_beneficiaries: All citizens, through stronger public health facilities.
key_features: Support for urban and rural health centres

name: National Health Mission
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementing_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The main central programme supporting states to run public health services, made up of the rural (NRHM) and urban (NUHM) missions.
coverage_amount: Free services at public health facilities.
eligibility: Open to everyone using public health facilities.
target_beneficiaries: All citizens, with focus on women, children and underserved areas.
key_features: Funds ASHA workers and health facilities
Supports maternal, newborn and child health
Free drugs and diagnostics at public facilities

name: Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementing_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Sets up new AIIMS-like institutes and upgrades government medical colleges so that advanced care and medical education are available in more regions.
eligibility: Open to patients at the participating institutions.
target_beneficiaries: Patients needing tertiary care; medical students and staff.

name: Central Government Health Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Health care for serving and retired central government employees and their eligible dependants, through wellness centres and empanelled hospitals.
coverage_amount: Cashless treatment as per CGHS rates. Contribution depends on pay level.
eligibility: Central government employees, pensioners, and certain other groups covered under the scheme, along with eligible family members.
target_beneficiaries: Central government employees, pensioners and dependants.
key_features: Cashless hospital treatment at empanelled hospitals
notes: Contribution slabs and empanelled hospital rates are revised periodically - verify current rates on official portal.

name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: A self-financed social security scheme giving medical care and cash benefits to workers in covered establishments.
coverage_amount: Full medical care plus cash benefits for sickness, maternity, disablement and dependants.
eligibility: Employees earning up to ₹21,000 a month (₹25,000 for persons with disabilities) in covered establishments.
target_beneficiaries: Workers in factories and establishments covered by the ESI Act, and their families.
key_features: Contributions from employee (0.75%) and employer (3.25%) of wages
Free medical care for insured person and family
income_note: Wage ceiling of ₹21,000 a month, or ₹25,000 for persons with disabilities.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: A cash incentive to encourage women to deliver in a government or accredited health facility rather than at home.
coverage_amount: Rural ₹1,400 and urban ₹1,000 in low performing states. ₹700 rural and ₹600 urban in high performing states.
eligibility: Pregnant women delivering in a government or accredited private facility; conditions differ between states.
target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women, with special focus on poor families.
key_features: ASHA worker helps with registration and transport

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free and cashless services for pregnant women and sick newborns at government health facilities.
coverage_amount: No out-of-pocket cost for delivery and newborn care in public facilities.
eligibility: All pregnant women delivering at public health facilities, and sick infants up to one year.
key_features: Free normal delivery and caesarean section
Free diet during the hospital stay
Free transport from home and back

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Children are screened for common health problems at birth, at Anganwadi centres and in schools, and referred for free treatment.
key_features: Looks for defects at birth, deficiencies, diseases and developmental delays
Screening at Anganwadis and government schools

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Every pregnant woman can get a free check-up by a doctor on the 9th of each month at public health facilities.
eligibility: Pregnant women in their second or third trimester, at public facilities.
key_features: Held on the 9th of every month
High risk pregnancies are identified and tracked

name: Mission Indradhanush / Intensified Mission Indradhanush
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementing_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Special campaigns to reach children and pregnant women who missed routine vaccination.
eligibility: Children up to 2 years and pregnant women who are not fully vaccinated.
target_beneficiaries: Unvaccinated and partially vaccinated children and pregnant women.
key_features: Focus on low coverage districts and hard to reach areas
Uses the U-WIN portal for tracking

name: Universal Immunization Programme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
implementing_body: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free routine vaccination for children and pregnant women against several vaccine-preventable diseases.
coverage_amount: Free vaccines at government health facilities.
eligibility: All infants and children up to the schedule ages, and pregnant women.
key_features: Given at sub-centres, health centres and outreach sessions

name: National TB Elimination Programme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free diagnosis and treatment for tuberculosis, with financial support for nutrition during treatment.

key_features: Free diagnosis and complete drug course
Support from a community volunteer (Ni-kshay Mitra)

name: National AIDS Control Programme

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

coverage_amount: Free dialysis sessions for eligible patients.

income_note: The test is state-defined BPL status. ₹1,00,000 a year approximates the BPL threshold.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
